prompt:
Generate ONE continuous realistic TEN-SECOND vertical 9:16 video at 720x1280. REFERENCE 1 is exact opening photograph. REFERENCE 2 is original product crop. REFERENCE 3 is CANONICAL CHARACTER PORTRAIT: same fictional adult face, ponytail and cream blouse whenever visible. Never cut to reference images or reveal a new person. Exactly ONE pastel lavender portable power bank as shown in product reference 1: a compact thick rounded rectangular smooth lavender body, glossy BLACK rounded-rectangle level window inset at one end of the broad front face, existing small white level markings, matching lavender loop strap and the original shell seam/visible side openings. Preserve the supplied body proportions and black window location. Do not add any brand, connector, port, cable, charging feature or invented value. The loop is treated only as a strap. Always show the existing front face at nearly its original three-quarter angle; only a small 5–8 degree yaw is permitted. Never expose an invented rear.
One bright clean product-review studio styled as a small electronics shop: pale oak counter, soft warm-white neutral wall and a few heavily blurred unbranded accessories, no readable signs or packaging. Broad FIXED diffuse studio key light plus fill at neutral 5200K. No visible window, sunlight beam, moving shadow, RGB lights or dark background transition. Keep identical bright exposure and neutral white balance in all scenes, especially the lavender body and cream sleeves.
CAMERA: fixed tripod at the opening viewpoint; at most 2 cm lateral slide, no orbit, push-in, upward tilt or auto zoom. Keep the full product and full loop in central 70% throughout. Preserve size. Only 5–8 degree natural hand turn specified below, no wide rotation or rear view. The brief pause must be performed by the woman, not a frozen or repeated frame. Tactile demonstration means fingers actually contact the blank shell with a plausible contact shadow; not pointing beside it. No finger penetrating, extra fingers or melting shell. Do not cover, press or change the black display. Keep all source proportions, lavender color, black window and original level markings. No connecting cables, animated charging, accessories or invented features. Lips remain closed and relaxed; this is product B-ROLL with independent narration, no speaking or lip-sync. 
EXACT ACTION TIMELINE:
0.0–1.0s: free hand rises visibly toward the body; supporting hand keeps product stable. 1.0–1.6s: brief natural steady pose to show shape, no edited freeze. 1.6–3.0s: slowly turn rigid product only 6 degrees and STOP, keeping original front view. 3.0–6.0s: two fingertips visibly touch the BLANK upper lavender face and gently slide down 2 cm, stopping BEFORE the black window. Keep a real small contact shadow, no fingers merging into shell. 6.0–7.5s: fingertips release; rotate back 6 degrees. 7.5–10s: settle into secure palm presentation; no extra spin.
No added text anywhere, including signs, subtitles, hook/CTA/spec cards, readable packaging or watermark. No music, speech or sound effects. No cuts, fade-in, fade-out, darkening, shadow sweep or exposure change.
STRAP COUNT LOCK: exactly ONE short flexible lavender loop attached at the SAME location as product reference 1. Keep its original approximate length, no longer than one product body length. Do not add a second loop, long wrist lanyard, cord, hanging extension, extra attachment or cable. The one original loop must be visible. Do not invent extra ports.

EXPOSURE CONTINUITY: identical bright diffuse studio illumination from the first to the last frame, locked camera exposure and white balance, no auto exposure ramp, no fade, vignette, dramatic grading, dimming or moving shadows. Preserve the opening photograph's product/skin brightness and colors. Camera motion must not cause the face, clothes or product to gradually darken.
